paragraphs.text: Blackbloom Lake is a marshy lake on the continent of Murasa on Zendikar .

The rushing Raimunza River runs from the base of the Na Plateau and wends its way to the edge of Kazandu . There, it falls onto the wide branch of a jaddi tree that grew under the water's flow. Now the river flows along jaddi branches for miles. While some stretches are relatively level and quiet, others dive like waterslides or fall from a great height only to be caught by another channel in a branch. Eventually, the river plunges into the marshy Blackbloom Lake in the center of Kazandu.
